buzzRounds.topic: CeeDee Lamb catches 17 passes to beat the Texans
buzzRounds.whatHappened: The Dallas Cowboys won 34-30 at the Houston Texans. CeeDee Lamb caught 17 passes for 189 yards, including the winning 12-yard touchdown with 40 seconds left, and Dak Prescott threw for 335 yards.
buzzRounds.whyCare: NFL.com says Lamb is only the fourth player in NFL history with 17 or more catches, 180 or more receiving yards and a touchdown in one game. Dallas is now 2-2 and Houston is 0-4.
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: CeeDee Lamb caught 17 passes for 189 yards against the Texans, and the last one was the winning touchdown with 40 seconds left. Only three other players in NFL history have had a game like that.

details.name: CeeDee Lamb
details.buzz: Lamb set a career high with 17 catches, and 11 catches for 140 yards and his touchdown came in the second half, per NFL.com.

details.name: Dak Prescott
details.buzz: NFL.com noted Prescott targeted Lamb 21 times on 45 routes, the most targets for a receiver running 45 or fewer routes in the Next Gen Stats tracking era.

buzzRounds.topic: Chiefs stay unbeaten behind Kenneth Walker III
buzzRounds.whatHappened: The Kansas City Chiefs beat the Las Vegas Raiders 30-27 to move to 4-0. Kenneth Walker III ran for 177 yards and two touchdowns, including the go-ahead 2-yard run with 3:21 left, and Patrick Mahomes threw two touchdowns.
buzzRounds.whyCare: NFL.com says Walker joins Jim Brown and O.J. Simpson as the only players in NFL history with multiple 170-yard rushing games in their team's first four games. The loss was the first of the season for the 3-1 Raiders.
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: The Chiefs are 4-0 after beating the Raiders 30-27, and Kenneth Walker III ran for 177 yards. Only Jim Brown and O.J. Simpson had ever put up two 170-yard games in their team's first four.

details.name: Kenneth Walker III

lastGame.label: Week 4 at Las Vegas Raiders, won 30-27

details.buzz: Walker scored the go-ahead touchdown from 2 yards and then a 22-yard clincher after a Raiders kickoff fumble, and he also had a 76-yard run.

details.name: Patrick Mahomes

lastGame.label: Week 4 at Las Vegas Raiders, won 30-27

details.buzz: Mahomes completed only half his passes, but his 55-yard throw to Tyquan Thornton set up the go-ahead score, per the CBS Sports recap.

buzzRounds.topic: Eagles blow a 10-point lead to the Rams
buzzRounds.whatHappened: The Philadelphia Eagles led the Los Angeles Rams 20-10 at halftime at home, did not score again, and lost 24-20. Jalen Hurts threw for 93 yards, and Puka Nacua caught 9 passes for 125 yards for the Rams.
buzzRounds.whyCare: The Eagles went 0 for 12 on third downs, their most tries without a conversion since at least 1991, per NFL.com, and both teams are now 2-2.
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: The Eagles were up 20-10 on the Rams and never scored again, losing 24-20. They went 0 for 12 on third downs, and Jalen Hurts threw for just 93 yards.

details.name: Jalen Hurts

lastGame.label: Week 4 vs Los Angeles Rams, lost 24-20

details.buzz: NFL.com says the 93 yards were the fewest Hurts has thrown for in a game he started and finished.

details.name: Puka Nacua
details.buzz: Nacua caught 9 passes for 125 yards as the Rams came back, with Kyren Williams scoring twice late, per NFL.com.

details.buzz: Reichard scored all 15 Vikings points against Miami and has now made 31 straight field goals.

details.name: T.J. Hockenson
details.buzz: Hockenson caught 13 passes for 119 yards, Kyler Murray's top target in a game where the Vikings gained 336 yards, their highest total of the season, per NFL.com.

New England Patriots.latestResult: Won 29-26 at the Buffalo Bills in Week 4 (now 2-2)
New England Patriots.storyline: Drake Maye threw 3 touchdowns and led a game-winning 73-yard touchdown drive to hand the Bills their first loss and get the Patriots back to 2-2.
New England Patriots.bringUp: Drake Maye beat the Bills 29-26 in Buffalo with three touchdown passes and a game-winning 73-yard touchdown drive. He was also the Patriots' leading rusher with 54 yards.

details.name: Drake Maye
details.buzz: Maye threw for 269 yards and 3 touchdowns, ran for a team-high 54 yards and drove 73 yards for the winning score in Buffalo.

details.name: Romeo Doubs
details.buzz: Doubs caught 2 of Maye's 3 touchdown passes in the 29-26 win over Buffalo.

New Orleans Saints.latestResult: Lost 45-24 to the Atlanta Falcons at home on Monday night in Week 4 (now 1-3)
New Orleans Saints.storyline: The Saints gave up 45 points to the Falcons on Monday night, the third time in four games they have allowed at least 31.
New Orleans Saints.bringUp: The Saints gave up 45 points to the Falcons at home Monday night, and that's the third time in four games they've allowed 31 or more. Alvin Kamara still scored twice.

details.name: Tyler Shough
details.buzz: Shough threw 48 passes for 286 yards as the Saints chased a big deficit in the 45-24 loss to Atlanta.

details.name: Alvin Kamara
details.buzz: Kamara ran for 2 touchdowns on only 7 carries in the Monday night loss to the Falcons.

New Orleans Saints.source: CBS Sports box score (https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/gametracker/boxscore/NFL_20261005_ATL@NO/); CBS Sports (https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/nfl-week-4-grades-for-all-32-teams-bears-bengals-patriots-rams/)

New York Giants.latestResult: Beat the Arizona Cardinals 36-24 at home in Week 4 (now 3-1)
New York Giants.storyline: The Giants are 3-1 after Deonte Banks sealed a 36-24 win over Arizona with a 98-yard interception return for a touchdown on the final play, one of three Giants interceptions.
New York Giants.bringUp: The Giants are 3-1. Deonte Banks returned an interception 98 yards for a touchdown on the last play to finish off Arizona 36-24, and their defense picked off three passes that day.

details.name: Deonte Banks
details.buzz: Banks sealed the 36-24 win with a 98-yard pick-six, meaning an interception returned for a touchdown, on the final play.

details.name: Jameis Winston
details.buzz: Winston threw 3 touchdowns and 2 interceptions in a wild game that had five interceptions and 60 combined points.

New York Jets.latestResult: Lost 23-12 at the Chicago Bears in Week 4 (now 1-3)
New York Jets.storyline: Minkah Fitzpatrick's interception in Chicago was the Jets' first in 637 days, but the defense never forced a punt and the Jets have now lost three straight, all to NFC North teams.
New York Jets.bringUp: Minkah Fitzpatrick picked off a pass against the Bears, and it was the Jets' first interception in 637 days. They still lost 23-12, their third loss in a row.

details.name: Minkah Fitzpatrick
details.buzz: CBS Sports called his interception the team's first in 637 days, the one bright spot in a D-graded loss.

details.name: Geno Smith
details.buzz: His only touchdown was a 58-yard deep pass in the fourth quarter; the Jets' other points came on two field goals.

Philadelphia Eagles.latestResult: Lost 24-20 to the Los Angeles Rams at home in Week 4 (now 2-2)
Philadelphia Eagles.storyline: The Eagles went 0 for 12 on third downs against the Rams, their most attempts without a conversion since at least 1991, and have now lost two straight.
Philadelphia Eagles.bringUp: The Eagles went 0 for 12 on third down against the Rams, the most tries without converting since at least 1991, and lost 24-20 at home.

details.name: Jalen Hurts

lastGame.label: Week 4 vs Los Angeles Rams, lost 24-20

details.buzz: NFL.com noted Hurts played without top targets DeVonta Smith and Dallas Goedert; both of his touchdown passes went to Darius Cooper.

Pittsburgh Steelers.latestResult: Lost 27-24 at the Cleveland Browns on Thursday night in Week 4 (now 2-2)
Pittsburgh Steelers.storyline: Aaron Rodgers threw for 299 yards and 3 touchdowns but also 2 interceptions as the Steelers fell 27-24 in Cleveland, a loss CBS Sports said exposed an inconsistent offense and a defense that keeps giving up big plays.
Pittsburgh Steelers.bringUp: Aaron Rodgers threw three touchdowns in Cleveland last Thursday, but he also threw two picks and the Steelers lost 27-24 to drop to 2-2.

details.name: Aaron Rodgers
details.buzz: Two of his three touchdown passes came in the fourth quarter, and he ran in a two-point conversion after the last one, but Pittsburgh still came up 3 points short.

details.name: DK Metcalf
details.buzz: Metcalf led the Steelers with 115 receiving yards in Cleveland, including a 43-yard catch.

San Francisco 49ers.latestResult: Beat the Denver Broncos 24-14 at home in Week 4 (now 4-0)
San Francisco 49ers.storyline: Brock Purdy hasn't been sacked all season: CBS Sports says the 49ers are the first team in 21 years to start 4-0 without giving up a sack, and they visit the 3-1 Seahawks in Week 5.
San Francisco 49ers.bringUp: The 49ers are 4-0 and Brock Purdy still hasn't been sacked. CBS says they're the first team in 21 years to start 4-0 without allowing one.

details.name: Brock Purdy
details.buzz: Per CBS Sports, he went 9 of 10 for 129 yards and both touchdowns on the 49ers' last three drives after a 10 of 20, 89-yard start.

details.name: George Kittle
details.buzz: Kittle's 56-yard touchdown catch with 2:15 left was the 49ers' final score against Denver.

Seattle Seahawks.latestResult: Beat the Los Angeles Chargers 30-23 at home in Week 4 (now 3-1)
Seattle Seahawks.storyline: Seattle led 27-6 before nearly blowing it, sealing the win with a strip-sack (a sack that knocks the ball loose) of Justin Herbert in a game with 30 combined penalties, and now hosts the 4-0 49ers.
Seattle Seahawks.bringUp: The Seahawks beat the Chargers 30-23 in a game with 30 penalties between the two teams. They were up 27-6 and had to hang on with a late strip-sack.

details.name: Emanuel Wilson

lastGame.label: Week 4 vs Los Angeles Chargers, won 30-23

details.buzz: NFL.com highlighted his 120 yards from scrimmage on 24 touches, and he scored once running and once receiving.

details.name: Sam Darnold

lastGame.label: Week 4 vs Los Angeles Chargers, won 30-23

details.buzz: Darnold threw touchdowns of 23 yards to Emanuel Wilson and 6 yards to Tory Horton as Seattle built its 27-6 lead.

Tampa Bay Buccaneers.latestResult: Lost 17-14 to the Green Bay Packers at home in Week 4 (now 0-4)
Tampa Bay Buccaneers.storyline: With Baker Mayfield out, undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels started and threw two interceptions in Packers territory that led to 10 Green Bay points in a 3-point loss.
Tampa Bay Buccaneers.bringUp: The Bucs are 0-4 after losing 17-14 to Green Bay with undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels starting for Baker Mayfield. His two interceptions led to 10 Packers points.

details.name: Jalon Daniels

lastGame.label: Week 4 vs Green Bay Packers, lost 17-14

details.buzz: CBS Sports said the undrafted rookie showed flashes, and he also ran 8 times for 55 yards, but his two picks were the difference.

Tennessee Titans.latestResult: Lost 24-18 at the Baltimore Ravens in Week 4 (now 0-4)
Tennessee Titans.storyline: The Titans have lost three straight games by six points or fewer, and Carnell Tate had 9 catches for 145 yards in Baltimore.
Tennessee Titans.bringUp: The Titans are 0-4, but their last three losses were all by six points or fewer. Carnell Tate just had 9 catches for 145 yards against the Ravens.

details.name: Carnell Tate
details.buzz: CBS Sports said Tate more than made up for a fumble in Ravens territory late in the first half with his 145-yard day.

details.name: Cam Ward
details.buzz: Ward was intercepted on his second pass of the game, which quickly became a Ravens touchdown, then threw a 3-yard touchdown with 1:12 left.

Washington Commanders.latestResult: Lost 30-13 to the Indianapolis Colts in London in Week 4 (now 1-3)
Washington Commanders.storyline: With Jayden Daniels already out, Marcus Mariota went down in the first quarter and rookie Athan Kaliakmanis, the third-string quarterback, played the rest of a 30-13 loss in London.
Washington Commanders.bringUp: The Commanders lost 30-13 to the Colts in London with their third-string quarterback, rookie Athan Kaliakmanis, playing most of the game after Marcus Mariota went down early.

details.name: Athan Kaliakmanis
details.buzz: NFL.com noted he was 13 of 31 for 91 yards outside of two big plays, one of them a 47-yard touchdown; Washington hosts the Giants in Week 5.
